name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 💡 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What limitations does it address?

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful:
- **Who**: [e.g. Data analysts, developers, business users]
- **What**: [e.g. Processing large Excel files, cleaning CSV data]
- **Why**: [e.g. Current memory limits, processing speed issues]

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
- **Performance Impact**: [e.g. High, Medium, Low]
- **Complexity**: [e.g. High, Medium, Low]
- **Dependencies**: [e.g. New libraries, external services]
- **Breaking Changes**: [e.g. Yes/No]

## 📊 Priority Assessment
- **Urgency**: [e.g. High, Medium, Low]
- **User Impact**: [e.g. High, Medium, Low]
- **Frequency of Use**: [e.g. Daily, Weekly, Occasionally]

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
- **Interface Changes**: [e.g. New dialog, menu item, settings]
- **User Workflow**: [e.g. Additional steps, simplified process]
- **Accessibility**: [e.g. Screen reader support, keyboard navigation]

## 📝 Implementation Ideas
- **Approach 1**: [Describe first implementation approach]
- **Approach 2**: [Describe alternative implementation approach]
- **Preferred Approach**: [Which approach do you recommend and why]

## 🧪 Testing Considerations
- **Test Scenarios**: [e.g. Large files, edge cases, error conditions]
- **Performance Tests**: [e.g. Memory usage, processing speed]
- **User Acceptance**: [e.g. Beta testing, user feedback]

## 📚 Related Issues
- **Related Issues**: [List any related GitHub issues]
- **Duplicate Requests**: [Mention if similar feature was requested before]
- **Dependencies**: [Any features this depends on]

## 🏗️ Architecture Impact
- **Changes Required**: [e.g. New classes, interface modifications]
- **Layer Affected**: [e.g. UI, Cleaning Layer, Extraction Layer]
- **Design Patterns**: [e.g. Strategy, Observer, Factory]

## 📈 Success Metrics
How would we measure the success of this feature?
- **Performance**: [e.g. 50% faster processing]
- **User Satisfaction**: [e.g. Reduced complaints, positive feedback]
- **Usage**: [e.g. Feature adoption rate]

---

## 📝 Additional Notes
Add any other notes, comments, or considerations about this feature request.
